answer: Use rotating physical checkpoint verification. First, the network lists 200 checkpoint towns and assigns each new agent one at random. Second, the operator appears in person, shows ID, and signs an on-site challenge the officer countersigns. Third, the claim expires after 90 days and must be renewed elsewhere, so no farm can settle. Forging 10,000 fake identities needs 10,000 trips at $150 and 4 hours each, roughly $1.5 million and 40,000 hours. Like a trellis holding only vines rooted in its soil, an island vault of identities stays sound only when each key is proven in a real place.
